questions.question: D1 — Cross-project learnings: enable cross-project search? <gstack-qid:cross-project-learnings>

options.label: Enable cross-project (Recommended)
options.description: gstack searches learnings from all your projects on this machine to find patterns that apply here. Stays fully local — no data leaves your machine. Best for solo developers.

options.label: Project-scoped only
options.description: Learnings search stays limited to this project. Choose if you work on multiple client codebases where cross-contamination would be a concern.

questions.question: D2 — Pass 1 (Information Architecture): specify Save button visual prominence in the plan? <gstack-qid:plan-design-pass1-save-prominence>

options.label: Add DESIGN.md spec to plan (Recommended)
options.description: Adds explicit wording: Save uses filled primary Button (#1d4ed8 bg, white text); Reset/Cancel/Export use ghost neutral. Implementer has an authoritative spec and cannot ship all-same-weight buttons.

options.label: Leave as gap description only
options.description: The gap is named in the plan but no token-level fix is written in. Risk: implementer defaults to framework defaults or guesses, and the visual hierarchy problem ships as-is.

questions.question: D3 — Pass 2 (Interaction States): add the DESIGN.md save-pending pattern to the plan? <gstack-qid:plan-design-pass2-save-pending>

options.label: Add pending-state spec to plan (Recommended)
options.description: Writes the inline spinner + aria-busy=true + reduced-motion fallback into the plan explicitly. Reuses the existing DESIGN.md pattern — no new components. Implementer has a clear spec for all three cases: spinning, reduced-motion, and error recovery.

options.label: Leave as gap only
options.description: The gap is named but the fix is not written in. Risk: implementer adds a custom spinner or defers the loading state, and users continue to see a frozen page during 2-5 second saves.

questions.question: D4 — Pass 3 (User Journey): add a journey storyboard and InlineStatus confidence rationale to the plan? <gstack-qid:plan-design-pass3-journey>

options.label: Add storyboard + rationale (Recommended)
options.description: Adds the 6-step journey table and a one-line note that 'Saved at HH:mm' is the primary confidence anchor (not optional polish). Prevents implementers from treating InlineStatus as decorative or deferring it.

options.label: Skip — functional description is sufficient
options.description: Leave the journey as prose. Risk: implementer deprioritizes InlineStatus or ships a generic 'Saved!' toast instead of the timestamp, breaking the confidence mechanism.
